posts.text:
The Save America Act is simple: Go back to Election Day—not election month—and require voters to prove they are who they say they are. 

That’s how we earn back the American people’s trust.
posts.summary: Backs voter ID requirement to restore election integrity
posts.quote:
The Save America Act is simple: Go back to Election Day—not election month—and require voters to prove they are who they say they are. 

That’s how we earn back the American people’s trust.

posts.text: The SAVE Act restores confidence in our elections by ensuring only American citizens vote in American elections.
posts.summary: Supports SAVE Act to ensure only citizens vote in elections
posts.quote: The SAVE Act restores confidence in our elections by ensuring only American citizens vote in American elections.

posts.text: I fought to offer the SAVE Act as an amendment during the last vote-a-rama — and I’ll keep fighting until it passes.
posts.summary: Committed to passing SAVE Act through legislative action

posts.text:
Let me set the record straight for those who can read.

I have been voicing my strong support for the SAVE Act since it's been introduced.

As I said today, I will stand on one leg and bark like a dog if that’s what it takes to get this bill passed.
